anyOf.description: A Subgraph of Skills: the instructions an Actor follows to carry out a Task.
A Subgraph of Node Schemas: files that state the shape other files must have.
A Subgraph of Roles: the responsibilities an Actor takes on, and who takes them on.
A Subgraph of Processes: BPMN diagrams that coordinate Tasks, and the decision tables their gateways compute from.
A Subgraph describing the language models an Actor may be: which languages each is good at, and whether a person checked.

A Graph Typology a Harness defines. To a reader that knows only bootstrap it is an Extension: A field of a Declaration, or of one of its entries, that is not defined here. A reader that does not recognise the field ignores it, and the rest of the Declaration keeps its meaning.

GraphTypology.description: A named set of Node Kinds.
